about_text: I am a Backend Developer with a Cloud Engineer soul. While I master the Full Stack ecosystem (Java/Spring Boot, Angular, React), my current focus is on infrastructure robustness and DevOps automation. I enjoy designing architectures that don't just work, but scale: from Docker orchestration to implementing advanced security and CI/CD workflows. My goal is to bridge the gap between code and final deployment.
experience_text1: - Cloud Infrastructure: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Foundations Associate Certified. Specialist in migrating services to self-hosted environments on A2 instances, container management with Docker/Dokploy, and SSL security automation with Nginx.
experience_text2: - 'Mecatron' Project: Core Backend development using Spring Boot and PostgreSQL. Implementation of Flyway for database versioning and CI/CD pipeline design to automate continuous deployments.
experience_text3: - 'Bookigo' Project: Backend Developer focused on security and location-based services. Implementation of centralized authentication with Auth0 and integration of geolocation logic for proximity services.
experience_text4: - 'FacuShop' Project: End-to-end E-commerce architecture. Spring Boot REST API, Angular client, and orchestrated deployment using Docker Compose on Linux servers.
experience_text5: - Automations ('Genie'): PostgreSQL data architecture integrated with n8n workflows and webhooks for intelligent logic agent management and variation processing.
